title: Bendix employee captured by the Tupamaros in Uruguay
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Bendix employee captured by the Tupamaros in Uruguay, about 1970s at Uruguay, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We had a guy, we lost a guy in Uruguay, uh was captured by the Tupamaros um right out of his office and I believe he was killed.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on the history of intelligence agencies, relays an account from the 1970s about a man who worked for Bendix, an American engineering and defence company, in Uruguay. As told, the man was seized straight out of his office by the Tupamaros, a guerrilla group in Uruguay, and Levenda says he believes the man was killed. It is told as a sign of how dangerous, and how tangled with intelligence work, such company postings could be.
